verdict.rationale: E2B is explicitly marketed as 'secure isolated sandboxes' with per-sandbox VM/microVM isolation, network on/off controls, and self-hosted infra, implying host secrets aren't reachable by executed code — but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation describing secret/credential isolation guarantees, threat model, or how host credentials are kept out of the sandbox filesystem/env. Internet access controls and isolated infra provide indirect support but leave key security claims unverified.
